item.question: How does the predictive performance of the CAREER model compare when using different lengths of career history data?
item.answer: The predictive performance of the CAREER model improves with longer career history data. Specifically, using 10 or 15 years of historical data significantly enhances prediction accuracy compared to just 5 years, highlighting a trade-off between model performance and the cost of collecting long-term career data.
